8.7.3.7.1 StartProtocol
[SWS_Dcm_01339] Definition of configurable interface Xxx_StartProtocol ⌈
Service Name
Xxx_StartProtocol
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Xxx_StartProtocol (
Dcm_ProtocolType ProtocolType,
uint16 TesterSourceAddress,
uint16 ConnectionId
)
Service ID [hex]
0x67
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
ProtocolType
Type of the protocol to be started
TesterSourceAddress
source address of the tester
Parameters (in)
ConnectionId
Unique connection identifier
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Request was successful.
E_NOT_OK: Request was not successful.
E_PROTOCOL_NOT_ALLOWED: Protocol not allowed
Description
This function allows the application to examine the environment conditions and enable/disable
further processing of the protocol.
Available via
Dcm_Externals.h
⌋()
